Microsoft's C++ standard library (STL), vendored for NovaOS
============================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/STL, tag vs-2022-17.13
(commit 5e0ddadefd38b9ab50f2b8772ad4cb001133fd9d), the last release
that builds with clang 18.  Kept: stl/inc (the headers, without
header-units.json) and the stl/src files msvcp140.dll, its satellite DLLs
and the static part of the import library (msvcprt.lib) are built from;
stl/src's stacktrace.cpp and vector_algorithms.cpp are left out (NovaOS
builds with _USE_STD_VECTOR_ALGORITHMS=0 and has no DbgEng).
stl/src/special_math.cpp (msvcp140_2.dll, the C++17 special math
functions) builds on the Boost.Math headers in third_party/boost-math.

userland/msvcp140/build.py compiles them with clang in MSVC mode against
MinGW-w64's headers and the shim headers in userland/msvcp140/inc (the
VC runtime's private headers the sources include).  At build time it
patches two things in its copies of the sources (the files here are
unchanged): one explicit specialization clang wants marked "template <>"
(wlocale.cpp), and "#pragma init_seg(compiler)"/"(lib)" become named
sections, so each source's static initializers keep their order under
clang.  See userland/msvcp140/build.py.
